newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Esprit, MRCB, Hospital Pantai suspended.
newsitem.headline: Esprit, MRCB, Hospital Pantai suspended.

text.p: The stocks of Esprit Group Bhd, Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB) and Hospital Pantai Bhd were all suspended on Wednesday at the companies' requests, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said.
Engineering concern Esprit stock closed at 13 ringgit on Tuesday. Its officials could not immediately be reached for comment.
MRCB, a diversified concern whose interests include media and construction, closed at 9.70 ringgit on Tuesday. Its officials were not available for comment.
Shares of Hospital Pantai, which runs medical centres, closed at 11.10 ringgit on Tuesday. A company official said she did not know the nature of any news announcement.
